# Biometric Authentication Bypass Techniques

Biometric authentication systems have become increasingly prevalent in securing financial transactions and personal data. These systems leverage unique biological traits, such as fingerprints, facial recognition, and iris scans, to verify identity. However, as with any security measure, they are not impervious to sophisticated bypass techniques. This subsection outlines several methods employed by fraudsters to circumvent biometric authentication, supported by real-world implementations, detection evasion strategies, and potential countermeasures.
